threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it the Tube instead of the Overground—dead giveaway you're not from around here.
Heard a bloke on the N63 arguing with a pigeon last night. Said it was the only one that wouldn't judge him. Classic Peckham vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I noticed my favorite café started serving Turkish coffee alongside vegan pastries—now that’s a blend you only find in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a spontaneous street vendor selling fresh currywurst with homemade vegan sauce at 3 AM after a night out.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know to carry an umbrella in their bag but still leave it closed—just in case the sun comes out between fog spells.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the 19 bus. He was just casually scrolling his phone, like it was the most normal thing to do in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all locals meet at Plaça del Sol, but many prefer the quietude of the hidden squares like Viaducte de Vallcarca to avoid the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones still taking pictures of the building façades, not realizing they’re just a prelude to losing a shoe on the cobblestones.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'takeaway' instead of 'takeout' and get puzzled by the endless options for vegan options at the pub.
Caught a bloke on the 59 last night trying to impress a girl with his deep knowledge of obscure Brixton history—she looked utterly bewildered.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a group of kids using the bus stop as a stage for their impromptu dance-off - that's when I knew this place has its own vibe.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s not uncommon to spot a spontaneous dance party at a U-Bahn stop, fueled by street musicians and good vibes. Just Berlin life!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they can name three taco trucks and have a favorite based on time of day. Tourist just ask for the nearest one.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that stopped mid-route so the driver could give a homeless man some change. No one seemed surprised, just another day in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think every corner café is for them, but some locals still play cards in the back, hiding the good conversations from outsiders.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by how they keep their jackets on while dining outdoors at La Plaça, unaware locals have moved on to enjoying the chill.
